body.name: Exact graph-legality stratum
body.construction: For each pair \(T,G\), form \(\Psi_{T,G}(p_T)\) from the complete invariant index \(\mathcal I_T\): use \(Z_e(T,p_T)>0\) exactly for the actual directed-parent and source-child incidences, use \(Z_e(T,p_T)=0\) for their complements, and mechanically compute latent-and-selection projection. The table comparisons defining \(Z_e\) range over all endogenous inputs, including configurations outside the observational support.
